source: openai/GPTs-are-GPTs full_labelset.tsv (O*NET task statements, Eloundou et al. labels)
transformations: O*NET-SOC code -> 6-digit SOC -> OEWS May 2021 code (broad code where OEWS publishes the broad occupation; explicit crosswalk ONET_TO_OEWS_2021 for SOC-2010-era codes)
weight = Core 2 / Supplemental 1 (Eloundou coreweight; missing Task Type -> 1), normalized within occ_code
exposure_label = human_labels where present else gpt4_exposure (label_source column records which)
beta from the row's beta column
use_case (EU AI Act Annex III / Art. 50) keyword-rules v1 (E)
notes: Labels and weights are real (status real); modality, presence, use_case and consequence_high are E-tagged keyword rules (aiwsim.data.classify) to be replaced by O*NET Work Context / GWA on ingest.
